title: Model debut orchestration and localized release playlist
creator: Anika Patel
description:
Purpose: Consolidate the cross-functional steps required to take a new model variant from catalog intake to public availability with localized release materials and staggered channel announcements. This playlist differs from standard model launch checklists by emphasizing simultaneous localization, staggered region gating, and targeted benchmark-to-doc synchronization.

Scope:
- Catalog metadata readiness (name, tags, capabilities, safety labels, cost profile).
- Benchmarks: microbenchmarks for latency/cost, qualitative evals for quality regressions, and representative prompt sets per locale.
- Docs & samples: localized quickstarts, SDK snippets, release notes in EN/ES/DE/JP, and usage examples with recommended routing policies.
- Announcements: staged messaging plan for dashboard, changelog, blog, customer newsletter, and partner channels.
- Operational: rollout canaries, fallback model mappings, monitoring dashboards, alert thresholds and incident playbooks.

Checklist (workstreams and acceptance criteria):
1) Catalog & Metadata (owner: PM)
   - Confirm canonical model display name, slug, description (EN + localized variants).
   - Tags: capability tags, input/output formats, family, quantization/version.
   - Pricing guidance: suggested per-token tiers and recommended dedicated sizing.
   - Acceptance: metadata fields populated in catalog UI and API, preview card approved by Design.

2) Benchmarks & Evals (owner: Research/Applied ML)
   - Run throughput/latency profiles across sequence length buckets on hosted and dedicated tiers.
   - Run localization-sensitive evals: hallucination rate, translation coherence for each target locale.
   - Generate benchmark report and delta vs baseline model; attach to ticket.
   - Acceptance: no >10% regression on quality metrics; latency within catalog-2026.03 SLO for target tier.

3) Docs & Samples (owner: Docs)
   - Quickstart: 3 minimal examples (text generation, chat, embeddings) per locale.
   - SDK snippets: Node/Python with streaming and function-calling examples; local times/dates localized.
   - Release notes: summary, compatibility, migration notes, known limitations.
   - Acceptance: PR merged, smoke run of examples, localization QA passed for top 3 markets.

4) Design & UX (owner: Design)
   - Create catalog preview tile and localized screenshots for Console.
   - UX copy for rollout banners and feature flags.
   - Acceptance: design signoff recorded in Figma link and screenshots uploaded.

5) Release Coordination & Comms (owner: PM Communications)
   - Build announcement schedule: internal beta -> partners -> public.
   - Draft blog post outline and customer email templates (with localized variants).
   - Prepare changelog entry and console banner content.
   - Acceptance: communications calendar entry, comms assets reviewed by legal if required.

6) Operational Readiness (owner: Engineering & SRE)
   - Canary rollout plan (percentages, regions, duration).
   - Monitoring dashboards: error rates, p99 latency, cost-per-token, quality regression alerts.
   - Fallback mappings and automated routing rules in case of capacity or quality regressions.
   - Acceptance: canary run (24h) with no high-sev alerts; rollback tested in staging.

7) Legal & Compliance (owner: Security/Legal)
   - Confirm model licensing and data usage notes for each locale.
   - KMS/HSM configuration review for Private customers if applicable.
   - Acceptance: legal sign-off on release content and licensing language.

Risks and mitigations:
- Localization delays -> stagger regional releases and prioritize top markets.
- Quality regressions in non-English locales -> hold public launch until locale evals meet threshold or enable region-specific fallback.
- Unexpected cost spikes -> set temporary throttles and burst caps during first 72 hours.

Assets & links:
- Catalog intake form: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1abcCatalogIntake
- Benchmark report (internal): https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/model-catalog/benchmarks/31654
- Design mockups (Figma): https://www.figma.com/file/Example/Model-31654-Preview
- Docs PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/987
- Release blog draft: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1releaseblogdraft
- Console rollout dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/releases/31654

Post-release tasks (T+1 week and T+30 days):
- T+1 week: verify telemetry for top-20 prompts, monitor cost; capture customer feedback channels.
- T+30 days: run a quality regression sweep across locales, evaluate performance vs forecast, update catalog guidance if necessary.

Notes: This playlist intentionally decouples canonical catalog publication (the earliest moment model appears in the catalog) from the public announcement cadence. PM team to own gating decisions based on benchmark deltas and localization readiness.
